verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents multi-provider LLM support via native SDKs, and YAML config explicitly designed to 'version control agent settings' and 'easily switch between different models' without rewriting agent code, plus community usage confirms swapping models (OSS vs proprietary) works for tool-calling capable models. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of zero-code-change provider swap across many providers, and detail on edge cases where provider-specific quirks require adjustment.
